summary: The filing is an 8-K by Benchmark 2026-B42 Mortgage Trust, a CMBS issuing entity, reporting entry into a material definitive agreement (pooling and servicing agreement) for the securitization of commercial mortgage pass-through certificates. It notes that a companion loan was securitized by a different trust, shifting servicing to that trust's PSA. There are no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or activist campaigns; this is routine CMBS documentation. The registrant is the issuer of asset-backed securities, filing a current report about a standard contractual update in a securitization structure.
